name: Kare (He)
source:
A mysterious young man whom the protagonist met.

His name and age are unknown. The place he introduces as his residence is a half-abandoned hospital that has gone out of business.

He shows the protagonist his "collection" of "sexual nightmares that women have had.

The purpose of this collection is a mystery.
